description: A receiver-authored record of an aircraft's transit through the receiver's coverage area. Created on departure. References all contributing batch sightings and the aircraft identity via strongRef for provenance verification.

main.description: A receiver's record of one aircraft's complete observed flight.

aircraft.description: Strong reference to the at.adsb.aircraft.identity record for this aircraft.

firstSeen.description: When this receiver first detected the aircraft.

lastSeen.description: When this receiver last detected the aircraft.

positionCount.description: Number of position reports received by this receiver.

messageCount.description: Total messages received from this aircraft by this receiver.

batches.description: Strong references to all at.adsb.receiver.sighting batch records where this aircraft appeared.

initialAltitudeFt.description: Barometric altitude in feet at first detection.

initialHeadingDeg.description: Ground track in degrees at first detection.

initialGroundSpeedKts.description: Ground speed in knots at first detection.

initialVerticalRateFpm.description: Vertical rate in feet per minute at first detection. Negative is descending.

finalAltitudeFt.description: Barometric altitude in feet at last detection.

finalHeadingDeg.description: Ground track in degrees at last detection.

finalGroundSpeedKts.description: Ground speed in knots at last detection.

finalVerticalRateFpm.description: Vertical rate in feet per minute at last detection. Negative is descending.

maxRangeNm.description: Furthest distance to this aircraft during the sighting, in nautical miles.
